title: Add autonomy dirty handoff report
summary: When Git metadata is read-only, autonomous work can be validated but not committed. Add a read-only handoff report that summarizes dirty files, diff stats, task state, and preflight blockers so another environment can resume without reverse-engineering the working tree.
expectedFailureModes: A blocked autonomous session leaves uncommitted work with no machine-readable handoff.
The report leaks machine-local paths or private identity metadata.
The report tries to stage, commit, push, or mutate Git metadata while documenting a dirty tree.
nextAction: Add an autonomy dirty-report command with text and JSON output, document it in autonomous workflow docs, and validate it against the current dirty tree.
